summary: This resolution expresses the sense of the House of Representatives that illicit fentanyl-related substances should be classified as weapons of mass destruction and permanently placed in Schedule I of the Controlled Substances Act.

scores.thoughts: This resolution is entirely focused on illicit fentanyl and fentanyl-related substances, advocating for their classification as weapons of mass destruction and permanent placement in Schedule I. This directly calls for stricter enforcement and classification of these drugs.

By advocating for the classification of fentanyl as a weapon of mass destruction and its permanent placement in Schedule I, the bill implicitly supports a stricter approach to criminal justice regarding drug trafficking and possession, emphasizing severe penalties for those involved with these substances.
